snapshot.description: Runtime validation requires both fields on every committed v5 header.

snapshotReason.description: Why a full snapshot was recorded; absent in older per-request headers.

AgentSessionEvent.description: Canonical UI wire contract for the append-only Agent Session Event Log. The envelope deliberately matches the Rust serde representation so fixtures, durable replay, and live events all use the same v4 data model.

cacheReadTokens.description: Provider-reported input tokens served from cache. Missing means unknown.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Provider-reported input tokens written to cache. Missing means unknown.

outputTokens.description: Provider-reported generated output tokens. Missing means unknown.

reasoningTokens.description: Provider-reported reasoning tokens. Missing means unknown.

totalTokens.description: Provider-reported total tokens. Missing means unknown.

uncachedInputTokens.description: Provider-reported input tokens that were not read from cache. Missing means unknown.

identity.description: Host identity carried by the backend so the disconnect is labeled even if the store record is gone.

DesktopEventPayloads.description: Fixed renderer events plus dynamic per-session ssh-data event payloads.
